from '@heroicons/react/24/outline/ShieldCheckIcon' function AdminModal({ open, admin, onClose, onSubmit, }) { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ name: '', phone: '', email: '', status: 'Active', }) const [error, setError] = useState('') // ========================================================= // LOAD ADMIN DATA // ========================================================= useEffect(() => { if (admin) { setFormData({ name: admin.name || '', phone: admin.phone || '', email: admin.email || '', status: admin.status || 'Active', }) } else { setFormData({ name: '', phone: '', email: '', status: 'Active', }) } setError('') }, [admin, open]) if (!open) { return null } // ========================================================= // HANDLE CHANGE // ========================================================= const handleChange = (event) => { const { name, value } = event.target setFormData((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value, })) setError('') } // ========================================================= // SUBMIT // ========================================================= const handleSubmit = (event) => { event.preventDefault() const name = formData.name.trim() const phone = formData.phone.trim() const email = formData.email.trim() if (!name) { setError('Admin name is required.') return } if (name.length < 2) { setError( 'Admin name must contain at least 2 characters.' ) return } if (!phone) { setError('Phone number is required.') return } if (!/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(phone)) { setError( 'Please enter a valid 10-digit phone number.' ) return } if (!email) { setError('Email address is required.') return } if ( !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email) ) { setError( 'Please enter a valid email address.' ) return } onSubmit?.({ name, phone, email, status: formData.status, }) } return (
